checks.title: Proxmox VE version reported
checks.rationale: Track the Proxmox VE major.minor release for patch-status tracking.
checks.remediation: Confirm pveversion output matches an approved support track.

checks.title: All packages are up to date
checks.rationale: Unpatched packages on the Proxmox host expose the hypervisor kernel and management stack.
checks.remediation: apt update && apt dist-upgrade (within an approved maintenance window).

checks.title: SSH root login is restricted (no plain password)
checks.rationale: Direct root password login on the hypervisor is a high-impact attack vector.
checks.remediation: Set 'PermitRootLogin prohibit-password' in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and reload sshd.

checks.title: Two-factor authentication is enabled for at least one PVE user
checks.audit: In the Proxmox UI: Datacenter > Permissions > Two Factor. Confirm at least one administrator has TOTP, U2F, or YubiKey configured.
checks.rationale: MFA on the management UI blocks credential-stuffing on exposed admin accounts.
checks.remediation: Configure TFA per-user in Datacenter > Permissions > Two Factor.

checks.title: Datacenter firewall is enabled
checks.command: pvesh get /cluster/firewall/options --output-format yaml 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/^enable:/ {print $2; exit}' | tr -d ' '
checks.rationale: Datacenter-level firewall is the hypervisor's host-based packet filter.

checks.title: Backup job exists (vzdump cron configured)
checks.rationale: A scheduled vzdump provides VM/container backup as a baseline DR control.
checks.remediation: Configure a backup job via UI: Datacenter > Backup.

checks.title: unattended-upgrades is enabled for security patches
checks.rationale: Automatic security upgrades close patch windows on the hypervisor host.
checks.remediation: apt install unattended-upgrades && systemctl enable --now unattended-upgrades.

checks.title: Manual: review storage backend encryption (ZFS native / LUKS)
checks.audit: Identify storage pools backing VM images. For ZFS: 'zfs get encryption'. For LUKS: 'cryptsetup status <device>'. Confirm encryption-at-rest matches policy.
checks.rationale: VM disks at rest are a high-value target; encryption mitigates physical-disk theft.
checks.remediation: Migrate VM storage to encrypted ZFS datasets or LUKS-backed volumes.

checks.title: Manual: review cluster TLS certificate trust chain
checks.audit: On each node, run 'pvecm status' and inspect /etc/pve/pve-root-ca.pem, /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.pem. Confirm the cluster CA and per-node certs are not self-signed defaults if exposing the UI externally.
checks.rationale: Replacing the self-signed defaults prevents trust prompts and enables certificate pinning by clients.
checks.remediation: Use 'pvenode acme cert order' (Let's Encrypt) or import an organization-issued cert.
